testimonials.name: Sarah K.
testimonials.quote: We hired Timmerman to build a large deck and pergola at our Mollymook property. From the first quote through to the final coat of oil, the whole experience was professional and stress-free. The quality of the timber work is exceptional — guests can't stop commenting on it.

testimonials.name: David & Paula R.
testimonials.quote: We did a full kitchen and laundry renovation and couldn't be happier. Timmerman's attention to detail in the joinery is second to none — everything is perfectly fitted, clean and exactly what we envisioned. He kept us informed every step of the way and finished on schedule.

testimonials.name: Mark T.
testimonials.quote: I've used Timmerman across two properties now — an extension on my home and a full fitout on my investment property. Both times the standard of work has been outstanding. He's my first call for anything building-related on the South Coast. Highly recommended without reservation.
